fields.title: PHASE 5 — Re-run Rules (Monthly) — Record of Application in This Edition
fields.md:
1. The state file was read first and the delta (Section 0) was written first. Only changes were used as grounds to adjust probability (Rule 1) and fair value (measured discount rate · baseline replacement) (source: Sections 0–3).
2. Progress was filled in for the 29 milestones for the first time (24 in progress · 5 unjudged). Consecutive misses: 0 (source: PHASE 2 scorecard).
3. Two rule definitions were fixed and recorded in state: the numerator and denominator definitions of annual revenue per GW, and 'achieved (early)' = 2 consecutive quarters.
4. The 2 proposed new rules were not reflected in the numbers and were written only as proposals.
5. The 11 forward-looking statements by Musk and the CFO were entered only in the milestone candidates table (state) (source: [earnings call transcript](https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/10/20/spacex-spcx-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript/)) — 3GW (year-end) · 13GW (end of 2027) · ARR $100 billion (year-end) · $500 billion–1 trillion (end of 2027) · weekly flights (2027-1H) · 6-month payback (next year) · Flight 15 catch "more than even odds" · Louisiana launch site 2029 · Starlink bandwidth 100x (3 years) · Tesla merger "a good idea" · Terafab 2027-05/06. Not one was used in the judgments.
6. Two corrections were stated at the beginning.

---
